items.title: EU AI Act: machine-readable marking transition
items.detail: Transition deadline for Article 50(2) machine-readable marking of AI-generated outputs for systems already on the market before 2 August 2026. Check scope and exceptions in the official regulation.

items.title: CES 2027 begins in Las Vegas

items.title: Fintech Meetup 2027

items.title: EU AI Act: Annex III high-risk obligations
